# jadix_glyphon maintained source

Upstream package: `glyphon` `0.12.0`.
Source: `repository-maintained-vendor`.
Base manifest SHA-256: `22905428dadb9e46c1cebb4e97a42f5adaae9a0eb791e2caf37e7a24722ede97`.

This maintained fork batches glyph atlas uploads using a CPU mirror and dirty rectangles, preserves glyph residency through atlas epochs, and adjusts fragment shader inputs for the D3D11/ANGLE path. These implementation changes and their regression coverage are described in [JADIX_PATCH.md](JADIX_PATCH.md). It also consumes Jadix's modified text and GPU implementations through versioned dependencies. Original copyright and license files are retained: LICENSE-APACHE, LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-ZLIB.

Package availability and ownership must be checked in the target registry; this provenance record identifies the maintained source.
